name: wikimedia-agent-tooling
description: Reusable Claude Code agent tooling (PR quality-gate skill, hooks, scripts) from the wikimedia-coding-agent-lessons repo.

plugins.name: agent-tooling
plugins.description: PR quality-gate skill + reusable hooks and scripts; agent-agnostic core with a Claude Code adapter.

plugins.name: wikimedia-data-collection
plugins.description: Claude Cowork skills for collecting Wikimedia data via official APIs (Action API, Wikidata SPARQL, REST/AQS, Phabricator Conduit) — API-first, never scraping.

plugins.name: robots-checker
plugins.description: Blocks fetches that would violate robots.txt and requires explicit confirmation before scraping a disallowed domain.

plugins.name: sources-linter
plugins.description: Validates sources.txt on every write: required fields, naming conventions, duplicate citekeys, access values.

plugins.name: fetch-interceptor
plugins.description: Routes WebFetch through a caching, rate-limited, archival fetch pipeline instead of ad-hoc network calls.

plugins.name: flushing-dataviz
plugins.description: Consistent, accessible chart and table styling for research figures (matplotlib + LaTeX booktabs): colorblind-safe, grayscale-print-safe, ICWSM/AAAI-sized, with paper/slides/poster styles.
